chunks: Ja'far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. 'Amir narrated to us from Mu'alla b. Muhammad al-Basri from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti from 'Ali b. Ja'far. He said: I heard Aba'l-Hasan Musa b. Ja'far (peace be upon him) say:

While the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) was sitting, an angel with twenty-four faces entered upon him. The Messenger of Allah said to him: My beloved Jibra'il, I have never seen you in such a form. The angel said: I am not Jibra'il. I am Mahmud. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has sent me to marry the light to the light. He (peace be upon him) said: Who to whom? He said: Fatima to 'Ali.

He said: When the angel turned away, behold, between his shoulders was written: 'Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, 'Ali is his deputy.' The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: How long has this been written between your shoulders? He said: Twenty-two thousand years before Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created Adam.

key_terms.النُّورَ مِنَ النُّورِ: light from light — a phrase indicating the spiritual and divine purity connecting Fatima and 'Ali, often interpreted as their shared heavenly origin
key_terms.مَحْمُودٌ: Mahmud — an angel unknown to the Prophet, whose name means 'the praised one', sent specifically for the divine proclamation of the marriage
key_terms.وَصِيُّهُ: his deputy/successor — the term wasi denotes the executor of the Prophet's will and his appointed successor, here referring to 'Ali b. Abi Talib

ai.seo_question: What angel announced the marriage of Fatima to Ali, and what inscription was found on its shoulders?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates a visitation of the Prophet by an unknown angel named Mahmud, who announces the divine sanction of the marriage between Fatima and 'Ali, describing them as 'light to light.' The hadith also reveals that the angel bears an inscription on his back declaring Muhammad as the Messenger of Allah and 'Ali as his deputy (wasi), a designation written twenty-two thousand years before the creation of Adam. This narration serves to establish the cosmic and pre-eternal sanction of 'Ali's succession and the special spiritual status of Fatima.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Masrur (rh) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. Muhammad b. `Amer narrated to us from Mu`alla b. Muhammad al-Basri from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti from `Ali b. Ja`far. He said: I heard Aba’l Hasan Musa b. Ja`far (as) say:

The Messenger of Allah (s) was sitting when an angel visited him. It had twenty-four faces. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said to him: My beloved Gabriel, I have never seen you in this form. So, the angel said: I am not Gabriel. I am Mahmud. Allah sent me to marry the light to the light. So, he (s) said: Who to who? He said: Fatima to `Ali.

He said: When he turned around, he saw that, between his shoulders, it was written: “Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, `Ali is his deputy.” So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: When was this written between your shoulders? So, he said: Twenty-two thousand years before Allah created Adam.
